title: Propose-and-blind-select completes the contrastive loop — recommendations never become decisions
summary: The PPC loop now covers candidate generation (LLM propose under a declared editable surface), isolated probes, axis classification, and anonymized blind selection — but blind selection outputs a recommendation for human_gate only; the decision axis remains the sole auto_advance authority.
hint_triggers: Imported harness2 loop-complete mechanics: (1) SurfaceSpec declares allowed overlay paths — off-surface proposals are rejected before probing; validate with allowMissingLeaf or the missing-dir branch is dead code and a typo kills the session. (2) Sanitize proposed paths for BOTH separators — a /-only split passes a\..\.. traversal on win32; reject backslash outright. (3) Blind selection anonymizes labels behind seeded letters so a judge weighs evidence not provenance — but its output is a recommendation, never a decision: auto_advance still requires metric dominance. Scrub the outcome label out of error text or a chatty candidate deanonymizes itself. (4) getReasoningBackend never throws — it returns the stub; backend honesty requires checking backend.name, otherwise a stub run reports backend_used:true. (5) Validate CLI numerics and candidate label charset upfront — mid-session throws burn probes and lose the report.
